requirements.quote:
While there are legitimate uses for all messages, implementations
   SHOULD track cost of processing relative to progress and treat
   excessive quantities of any non-productive packets as indicative of
   an attack.  Endpoints MAY respond to this condition with a connection
   error or by dropping packets.
requirements.condition: When processing messages or packets for a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Implementations should track processing cost relative to connection progress.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation or tests can verify that the implementation maintains or evaluates processing-cost information against connection progress.

requirements.condition: When an implementation observes excessive quantities of non-productive packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation should treat the observed packets as indicative of an attack.
requirements.why_checkable: A focused test can generate excessive non-productive packets and verify that the implementation classifies or handles the condition as an attack indication.

requirements.condition: When excessive quantities of non-productive packets are treated as indicative of an attack.
requirements.error_behavior: An endpoint may respond by producing a connection error or by dropping packets.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can trigger the stated attack condition and observe whether the endpoint chooses either permitted response.
